description: Brazil Transmission Network Dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Pedro Torres. This dataset is made available by the Independent System Operator of Brazilian Transmission Networks (Operador Nacional do Sistema - ONS) and has been modified to run the simulations in the paper: "Energy storage as a transmission asset – assessing the multiple uses of a utility-scale BESS in Brazil". Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
